output.reason: PMK 105/2025 grants a government-borne (DTP) PPh 21 incentive for 2026. It covers specific permanent employees whose regular gross income is at most Rp11,000,000. These employees must work for employers in certain sectors (footwear, textile and apparel, furniture, leather, tourism) that hold KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. The incentive is paid in cash to the employee and is not counted as taxable income. Any excess is not refunded. This changes the PPh 21 net-pay calculation for qualifying permanent employees in Masa Pajak January–December 2026.
